key.name: enabled
key.description: When off, mice are left untouched and scroll at their normal speed.

key.name: vertical-factor
key.description: Multiplier applied to vertical wheel scrolling. 1.0 is the normal speed.

key.name: horizontal-linked
key.summary: Horizontal speed follows the vertical speed
key.description: When on, horizontal wheel scrolling uses the vertical multiplier.

key.name: horizontal-factor
key.description: Multiplier applied to horizontal wheel scrolling when it is not linked to the vertical speed.

key.name: acceleration
key.description: How much further the view scrolls when the wheel spins fast. 0 disables acceleration.
